upstream.source_tree_digest_method: sha256 over the sha256 listing of `find src -type f -name '*.rs' | LC_ALL=C sort`

license_evidence.note: Original MIT package label is retained as historical evidence; the derivative manifest is corrected to Apache-2.0.
license_evidence.distribution_gate: Resolved: ship Apache-2.0 license text, HZR modification notices, both exact patches and corrected engine metadata.
license_evidence.resolution_source: Repository owner confirmed that upstream licensing was clarified as Apache-2.0.

patches.summary: Adds a read-only store reader, a bounded snapshot exporter and the `hzr-agtx-observer` binary. Makes `Database::hash_path` reachable as `observer_path_hash` and `dep_graph::parse_refs` reachable as `parse_referenced_task_ids`, so the observer shares the store layout and the dependency parse instead of copying them.
Corrects derivative Cargo license metadata and marks HZR-modified source files; no runtime behavior changes.

build.workspace: outside the HZR cargo workspace; the component is built from a temporary checkout of the pinned commit
build.upstream_tests_run: Patched lib: 534 passed together with the unchanged tmux slow-drain timing test excluded; that test passed separately (1/1). Combined serial suite had 534 passed and 1 timing failure on darwin-arm64. See docs/review/20260908_160000_agtx_Code-Review.md.
build.observer_tests_run: 25 observer tests included in the 534-test passing run; isolated AGTX_DATA_DIR, AGTX_CONFIG_DIR and AGTX_AGENT_HOME

safety.writes_to_source: none; SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY plus PRAGMA query_only=ON, no directory creation, no migration, no chmod, no journal-mode change
safety.starts_processes: none; no tmux, no coding agent, no MCP server, no web listener
safety.exports_free_text: Titles and branch labels only when the explicit include_titles request is enabled; disabled by default. No descriptions, PR URLs, worktree paths, notification prose, hook message/tool text or transcript paths are exported.

distribution.runtime_launch: Explicit hzr agents board only; observer never starts agents
